CLUE (The Chinese Language Understanding Evaluation) is a benchmark dedicated to scientific, objective, and neutral evaluation of language models, launched in 2019.
SuperCLUE is the evolution and continuation of the CLUE benchmark in the era of large models, focusing on comprehensive evaluation of general LLMs.
To reduce score fluctuations, models within a 1-point difference are treated as tied in ranking. International models and some domestic models are excluded from ranking and shown for reference only.
The question bank is 100% renewed every two months with all-original questions, eliminating overfitting risk.
The general leaderboard is updated every two months; other leaderboards are updated on an ad-hoc basis.
Leaderboards are generally sorted by total score in descending order. Metrics such as reasoning time, price, and hallucination rate are sorted in ascending order.
The Intelligence Index reflects model capability only and does not factor in reasoning efficiency or price.
A fully independent third-party evaluator that develops no proprietary models, committed to unbiased, objective, and neutral results.
The Intelligence Index is a composite score across multiple capability dimensions; the higher the score, the stronger the model's overall capability.

SuperCLUE has built a multi-domain, multi-level comprehensive benchmark framework for LLMs, covering general benchmarks, text benchmarks, multimodal benchmarks, reasoning benchmarks, Agent benchmarks, AI application benchmarks, and performance benchmarks

SuperCLUE encompasses three sub-tasks: actual users' queries and ratings derived from an LLM battle platform (CArena), open-ended questions with single and multiple-turn dialogues (OPEN), and closed-ended questions with the same stems as open-ended single-turn ones (CLOSE).
Our study shows that accuracy on closed-ended questions is insufficient to reflect human preferences achieved on open-ended ones.
600 questions are collected in total.

SuperCLUE从三个不同的维度评价模型的能力：基础能力、专业能力和中文特性能力。
针对于基础能力和中文特性能力题目，会有三位独立的人类测评员根据题目作答。人类测评结果，采用多数投票方式进行汇总，作为人类基准分数。
从人类测评角度看，基础能力（98%）+ 中文特性能力（95%），都达到了非常高的水平。
除GPT-4外，人类准确率大幅超过了其他的大模型（如在基础能力上超过其他模型20多个百分点）。
基础能力、中文特性能力：虽然每一部分都包含了10类子能力，但这两个能力的总数据量比较少，可能存在需要扩充数据集的问题。
选取模型的不完全：我们测试了9个模型，但还存在着更多的可用中文大模型。
多个维度能力考察（3大类，70+子能力）：从三个不同角度对中文大模型进行测试，以考察模型的综合能力；并且每一个子能力又含有十项或以上不同的细分能力。
相同的prompt情况下，让不同的模型对题目进行预测结果，与正确答案进行匹配，计算最终结果，并统计准确率（ACC）。

This evaluation comprises six tasks: mathematical reasoning, scientific reasoning, code generation (including web development), agent(task planning), hallucination control, and precise instruction following.
It features 998 questions and assesses 23 large language models from China and abroad.
Final scores are averaged across all tasks.
Evaluation Method：0/1 scoring based on reference answers: 1 point for consistency with references, 0 otherwise. No evaluation of the reasoning process.
Evaluation Method：Scored 0/1 via unit tests (for standalone function generation) and functional tests simulating user interactions (for web app generation).
Evaluation Method：A judge model discretely evaluates (0/1) completion of predefined checkpoints or continuously scores (0–100) overall plan quality.
Evaluation Method：Rule-based script 0/1 evaluation.
Evaluation Method：Binary (0/1) evaluation of hallucination per sentence, based on human-verified reference answers.
